integrity: Entire proof and checker are supplied; Monte Carlo and finite-ring enumeration are diagnostic and are not infinite-volume proofs. No independence claim or outside certification is made.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for adjacent sites in the infinite one-dimensional one-shot uniform-time antagonistic adsorption model, 0<p<1 and 0<t<=1; no claims for repeated attempts, long-range correlations or higher dimensions. Externally independent audit and comprehensive scholarly priority assessment are not performed.
title: Exact adjacent-pair law and opposite correlation signs in two-species one-shot adsorption
